benefits.name: Uber One Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 in statement credits per calendar year on Uber One membership fees charged directly to an eligible U.S. Consumer Platinum Card (monthly or annual plan).

benefits.name: Airline Fee Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 per calendar year in statement credits for incidental fees charged by your one selected qualifying airline (enrollment + airline selection required).

benefits.name: Oura Ring Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 per calendar year in statement credits on eligible Oura Ring purchases made online at ouraring.com (U.S. site).

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.description: $15 Uber Cash each month plus an additional $20 in December (total $200/year). Monthly Uber Cash expires at 11:59 PM Hawaii time on the last day of each month.

benefits.name: CLEAR Plus Credit
benefits.description: Up to $209 per calendar year in statement credits when you pay for an annual CLEAR Plus membership with the Platinum Card.

benefits.name: Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.description: Up to $25 per month (up to $300/year) for eligible purchases: Disney+, ESPN+, Hulu, NYT, Paramount+, Peacock, WSJ, YouTube TV/Music/Premium. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Equinox Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300 per calendar year in statement credits for U.S. eligible Equinox memberships or Equinox+ subscription.

benefits.name: lululemon Credit
benefits.description: Up to $75 in statement credits each quarter (up to $300/year) on eligible lululemon purchases at U.S. stores or lululemon.com. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Saks Credit
benefits.description: $50 statement credit issued twice per year (total $100 annually) for purchases at Saks Fifth Avenue stores or saks.com. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Resy Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits each quarter (up to $400/year) on eligible Resy purchases. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Hotel Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300 in statement credits semi-annually (Jan-Jun and Jul-Dec), up to $600/year, for eligible prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts and The Hotel Collection bookings.

multipliers.notes: Booked directly with airlines or Amex Travel
